# 2 Baruch Chapter 2 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Fall of Jerusalem

---

**1** "For I will not forget all the chastisement of my people, but only for a season shall it be forgotten.

**2** And I will remember them in the end of days and will restore them, because the name of Israel shall not be forgotten forever.

**3** And thereafter the adversaries shall fall and the enemies of Israel shall be destroyed, and Israel shall be exalted.

**4** And those who have been cast down shall be lifted up, and those who have been lifted up shall be cast down.

**5** And I shall punish those who have oppressed them, and I will chasten those who have trodden them underfoot, and I will comfort those who have mourned on account of Zion.

**6** For Israel is not given over to destruction, and those who have become scattered among the nations are not forgotten in the sight of the Lord.

**7** For the Lord created the world for the sake of Israel; and not because he loved a people has he done all this, but because he prepared it from the beginning for the sake of his people."

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal rendering. The eschatological reversal motif (v.4) echoes Hannah's song and the Magnificat. "End of days" is the standard apocalyptic terminus.*
